_nota: Nombres que ve la persona en el informe ingles. Misma decision que en castellano: se mantiene la nomenclatura original del BFI-2, sin renombrar, y por eso `renombradas` esta vacio. Los nombres de dominios y facetas son los oficiales del instrumento (Soto & John, 2017).

avisoComparacion.escala: The bands in this report indicate your position on the questionnaire's scale, not relative to a reference population.
avisoComparacion.baremo: The bands in this report are percentiles: they indicate your position relative to the reference sample cited at the end.

notas._nota: Aclaraciones que acompanan a un dominio cuando su nomenclatura tecnica puede leerse como algo que no es.
notas.negative_emotionality: The names of these three facets — Anxiety, Depression, Emotional Volatility — are the questionnaire's technical terms, and they describe normal tendencies of personality. They are not clinical conditions and have nothing to do with a diagnosis: a high score in Depression means you tend to register low mood more readily, not that you have a mood disorder.
